eligibility_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* HIV+ and provide evidence or documentation of HIV+ status
* Willing to release HIV-related health records
* Self-identify as a man who has sex with men
* Able to provide informed consent in English
* Be ≥50 years old
* Score at least a 2 on the PHQ-2 OR score at least a 4 on the UCLA Shortened Loneliness Scale

Exclusion Criteria:

* HIV-
* Does not self-identify as a man who has sex with men
* Is less than 50 years old
* Scores less than 2 on the PHQ-2 AND scores less than 4 on the UCLA Shortened Loneliness Scale
